') center center/cover no-repeat;transform-origin:50% 50%;transition:transform .8s ease,background-position .8s ease}body.fallback #fallbackScene{display:block}body.fallback #stage{display:none}body.fallback #bottomnote{display:block}#vignette{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 82% 75% at center,transparent 48%,rgba(29,19,26,.22) 100%)}

#status{position:absolute;top:18px;right:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:7px}.statuspill{background:#171923b9;border:1px solid #f2ce8d6c;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:30px;font-size:12px;color:#ffe8b8}.statuspill small{color:#cebba3}
#panel{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;width:min(415px,calc(100vw - 36px));padding:15px 16px}.panel-title{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.8px;color:#f3ca86;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:9px}.controlrow{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ctl{border:1px solid #947658;background:#ffffff0f;color:#fff0d5;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:11px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;transition:background .15s,transform .15s}.ctl:hover{background:#ffffff2b;transform:translateY(-1px)}.ctl.active{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ffdb94,#bc834a);border-color:#ffe3ae;color:#332537}.ctl:focus-visible,.seat-label:focus-visible,.player-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe9a6;outline-offset:3px}.controlrow+.controlrow{margin-top:8px}.minihelp{color:#ebdbc6;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:11px}.range{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.range span{font-size:11px;color:#d9c0a2;margin-right:3px}
#players{position:absolute;right:19px;top:111px;width:199px;padding:12px;max-height:calc(100vh - 160px);overflow:auto}#players .panel-title{margin-left:2px}.player-btn{width:100%;border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:#fcf0de;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px;border-radius:11px;text-align:left;transition:background .18s,border .18s}.player-btn:hover{background:#ffffff1c}.player-btn.active{border-color:#ffdfa183;background:#f0bc6440}.dot{width:25px;height:25px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--c);color:#443243;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 5px #fff8}.pname{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.3}.pdetail{font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;color:#dbc4aa}.player-main{flex:1;min-width:0}.coin{color:#ffdf88;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
#bubble{position:absolute;min-width:220px;max-width:275px;background:#fff9e9;color:#3d2d35;border:3px solid #c28c55;border-radius:19px;padding:12px 15px 11px;box-shadow:0 11px 30px #17121b80;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);visibility:hidden;transition:left .15s,top .15s;pointer-events:none}#bubble:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-15px;left:50%;width:22px;height:22px;background:#fff9e9;border-right:3px solid #c28c55;border-bottom:3px solid #c28c55;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg)}#bubble strong{font-size:12px;color:#8a573b}#bubble p{margin:5px 0;color:#37273a;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:900}#bubble small{font-size:11px;color:#94623c;font-weight:900}

#bottomnote{position:absolute;bottom:19px;right:236px;max-width:280px;pointer-events:none;text-align:right;color:#fff8e4;font-size:11px;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #2b1c25}

/* Step 5 card-gallery UI and phone-safe overlay */
#artDialog{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;z-index:300;background:#100d18d9;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);overflow-y:auto;padding:26px 18px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#artDialog.open{display:flex}
.art-panel{width:min(1100px,100%);max-height:calc(100vh - 38px);overflow:auto;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#33303c,#181924);border:1px solid #b8915e;border-radius:22px;padding:18px 20px 20px;box-shadow:0 35px 100px #0008}
.art-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:start}.art-head h2{font:700 clamp(18px,2vw,27px) Georgia,serif;color:#f8daa0;margin:1px 0 7px}.art-head p,.art-note{color:#d9c8b2;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 12px}.art-close{border:1px solid #d4ad79;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 13px;color:#fff3dc;background:#3e3440}
.art-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px;margin:14px 0}.art-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}.art-item img{width:100%;max-width:160px;aspect-ratio:720/1208;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 10px #100a1680);transition:transform .2s}.art-item img:hover{transform:scale(1.04)}.art-item span{font:700 11px Georgia,serif;color:#f5d49d;letter-spacing:.4px}.art-note{margin:6px 0 0}

@media(max-width:400px){.art-head h2{font-size:17px}.art-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

/* Step 5.4: 3D GLB validation HUD */
.avatar-panel{border-top:1px solid #f2d1a733;margin-top:14px;padding:12px 2px 3px}
.avatar-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}
.avatar{border:1px solid #b4a48e66;background:#251e26cc;color:#f4debe;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 5px;font-size:12px;transition:.2s}
.avatar span{font-size:21px;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
.avatar.active{border-color:#e8b55d;background:#7b553c;color:white;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #f7d79b}
.avatar-info{font-size:10px;color:#e0c9a8;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5}
#portraitBadge{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:120px;width:124px;z-index:7;background:#201824dc;border:1px solid #d9b87970;border-radius:13px;padding:5px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 8px 20px #18111a55}

#portraitBadge span{font-size:12px;color:#ffe2af;display:block;padding-top:4px;font-weight:700}
#portraitBadge small{font-size:9px;color:#e4cbb3;display:block;line-height:1.2;margin:3px 0}
@media(max-width:750px){#portraitBadge{width:90px;right:9px;bottom:145px}.avatar-choices{gap:4px}.avatar{font-size:10px;padding:5px}}

/* Live gameplay overlay. Preserve unobstructed camera controls and original modal choices. */
#demoBtn,#resetBtn,#modelInfoBtn{display:none!important}
#liveGameControls{position:fixed;left:min(445px,33vw);right:235px;bottom:16px;z-index:8;padding:12px 14px 11px;max-height:42vh;overflow:auto;pointer-events:auto;min-width:360px}
#liveGameControls h2{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 7px;color:#ffe0a5}

#gameActionButtons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
#gameActionButtons button,.live-extra button{font-size:12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #cfa86b;padding:9px 11px;background:#3c3343;color:#ffeac7;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}

#engineFrame{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:200;background:transparent;border:0;pointer-events:none}
#engineFrame.interacting{pointer-events:auto}

@media(max-width:750px){#liveGameControls{left:8px;right:8px;bottom:135px;min-width:0;max-height:32vh}#liveGameControls h2{font-size:12px}#liveHint,#liveLog{font-size:10px}#gameActionButtons button{font-size:10px;padding:7px 8px}#players{max-height:38vh}#portraitBadge{display:none}}

/* Step 6.1 — decisions are interactive character dialogue, not blurred legacy modals. */
#coupDecision[hidden]{display:none!important}
#coupDecision{
 position:fixed;bottom:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
 width:min(680px,calc(100vw - 34px));max-height:min(66vh,610px);overflow:auto;
 background:linear-gradient(130deg,#fff6e6 0%,#f4dfbe 100%);color:#372a2d;
 border:3px solid #be854d;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 18px 42px #1b121ba8,0 0 0 4px #fff4d66b inset;
 padding:15px 19px 13px;z-index:220;pointer-events:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
 animation:coupDecisionIn .18s ease-out;
}
@keyframes coupDecisionIn {from{opacity:.5;transform:translate(-50%,10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}}
.coup-dialogue-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
#coupDecisionPortrait{display:block;width:56px;height:56px;border:2px solid #c18e5d;border-radius:14px;object-fit:cover;background:#e8c8a2}
.coup-dialogue-titles{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.coup-dialogue-kicker{font-size:11px;color:#986034;font-weight:800}
#coupDecisionTitle{font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:#4e302c;line-height:1.28}
.coup-turnchip{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;background:#f0cf92;color:#654526}
#coupDecisionDesc{font-size:14px;line-height:1.62;margin:10px 0 12px;color:#4b3537;font-weight:600;white-space:normal}
.coup-dialogue-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(172px,1fr));gap:9px}
.coup-dialogue-options button{min-height:48px;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;border:2px solid #a18e77;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;text-align:center;background:#fffaf0;color:#3c3034;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 0 #6c4b2a30}
.coup-dialogue-options button:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.04)}
.coup-dialogue-options button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #246fcb;outline-offset:3px}
.coup-dialogue-options button.challenge-choice,.coup-dialogue-options button.danger{background:#a94350;color:#fff;border-color:#e39b9c}
.coup-dialogue-options button.block-choice{background:#47755e;color:#fff;border-color:#b1d2b7}
.coup-dialogue-options button.allow-choice,.coup-dialogue-options button.green{background:#eee1c5;border-color:#d0b98b;color:#624e38}
.coup-dialogue-options button:disabled{opacity:.52;cursor:wait}
.coup-choice-cards{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;justify-content:center}
.coup-choice-cards img{width:41px;height:56px;border:1px solid #b48248;border-radius:4px;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 1px 6px #20161250}
.coup-dialogue-foot{font-size:11px;margin:11px 0 0;text-align:center;color:#836344}
body.coup-answering #liveGameControls{opacity:.18;pointer-events:none!important}
body.coup-answering #bubble{visibility:hidden!important}
body.coup-answering #portraitBadge{opacity:.3;pointer-events:none!important}
@media(max-width:760px){#coupDecision{bottom:8px;max-height:70vh;padding:12px}#coupDecisionTitle{font-size:16px}.coup-turnchip{display:none}#coupDecisionDesc{font-size:12px}.coup-dialogue-options{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.coup-dialogue-options button{font-size:12px;min-height:44px}.coup-choice-cards img{width:33px;height:46px}}
@media(max-width:440px){.coup-dialogue-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}#coupDecisionPortrait{width:45px;height:45px}}


/* COUP 3D v3 — Comfort & Legibility update: stable camera, persistent private hand. */
#portraitBadge,#coupDecisionPortrait{display:none!important}
#bubble{position:fixed!important;top:110px!important;left:50%!important;transform:translateX(-50%)!important;
  min-width:260px;max-width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 42px));z-index:12;
  border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #1b121b90;transition:none!important;text-align:center}

#myHandDock{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;width:300px;z-index:28;
  background:linear-gradient(140deg,#211d2deb,#332734f4);color:#f9e8c7;
  border:2px solid #e7bd79;border-radius:16px;padding:11px 13px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 38px #160c1888;pointer-events:none}

#liveCards .my-card figcaption{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:#f7e4bb;white-space:nowrap}

#coupDecision{bottom:165px!important;max-height:min(58vh,540px)}

@media(max-width:1280px){#myHandDock{right:10px;bottom:10px;width:250px;padding:9px}#liveGameControls{right:275px!important}#liveCards .my-card img{height:93px!important;width:65px!important}#coupDecision{bottom:145px!important}}
@media(max-width:850px){#myHandDock{right:8px;bottom:8px;width:210px}#liveGameControls{left:8px;right:225px!important;bottom:160px;min-width:0}#liveCards .my-card img{height:83px!important;width:58px!important}#liveCards{min-height:96px}#bubble{top:125px!important}}
@media(max-width:650px){#myHandDock{width:188px;right:7px;bottom:7px}#liveGameControls{left:7px;right:7px!important;bottom:155px!important;max-height:26vh!important}#panel{bottom:6px!important;left:6px!important;width:calc(100vw - 208px)!important;max-height:140px;overflow:auto}#liveCards .my-card img{height:72px!important;width:50px!important}.my-hand-heading{font-size:10px}.my-hand-heading small{display:none}#coupDecision{bottom:151px!important;max-height:52vh!important}#bubble{top:108px!important;min-width:165px;font-size:12px}}

/* COUP — translucent ivory dialogues, no blurred game scene.
   Purely visual override. Challenge/Block rules, camera and models unchanged. */
#coupDecision {
  background: rgba(255, 247, 228, 0.60) !important;
  border: 2px solid rgba(177, 125, 72, 0.88) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(43, 25, 22, 0.24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.38) !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}
#coupDecisionTitle,
#coupDecisionDesc,
.coup-dialogue-kicker,
.coup-dialogue-foot {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.56);
}
#bubble {
  background: rgba(255, 248, 229, 0.60) !important;
  border: 2px solid rgba(181, 130, 76, 0.88) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 7px 23px rgba(40, 27, 24, 0.22) !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}
#bubble strong, #bubble p, #bubble small {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
}
/* Keep answer buttons clearly legible and clickable. */
.coup-dialogue-options button { box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(70,48,34,0.14); }


/* Deck-count label remains adjacent to the physical pile as the camera moves. */
#deckCountBadge{position:fixed;left:54%;top:43%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:35;pointer-events:none;
  padding:6px 11px;border:1.5px solid rgba(179,120,53,.85);border-radius:13px;
  background:rgba(255,239,205,.69);color:#452e20;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(39,25,20,.15);
  line-height:1.18;text-align:center;min-width:95px;text-shadow:0 1px #fff6e7;}
#deckCountBadge small{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1px}
#deckCountBadge span{display:block;font-size:14px;margin-top:1px;font-weight:600}
#deckCountBadge b{font-size:20px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#coupExchange[hidden]{display:none!important}
#coupExchange{position:fixed;left:50%;top:49%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:260;
 width:min(860px,calc(100vw - 36px));max-height:min(84vh,780px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
 padding:19px 22px 17px;border:2px solid #bc8d59;border-radius:24px;
 background:rgba(255,242,220,.86);color:#352a2a;box-shadow:0 14px 48px rgba(35,24,24,.5);
 backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;pointer-events:auto;}
.ex-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.ex-heading strong{font-size:21px;color:#573621;line-height:1.25}
.ex-step{font-size:12px;color:#76512d;background:#f2d9b1;border:1px solid #d7b075;border-radius:20px;padding:5px 9px;font-weight:bold;white-space:nowrap}
#coupExchangeCaption{font-size:13px;margin:8px 0 12px;color:#6c4935;line-height:1.55}
#coupExchangeCards{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-evenly;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ex-section{flex:1;min-width:210px;max-width:360px;padding:11px 12px;border:1px solid #d8b787;border-radius:15px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.ex-section h3{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 9px;color:#624532}
.ex-new{border-color:#bc8741;background:rgba(255,223,169,.30)}
.ex-cardrow{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ex-card{width:90px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:center;padding:5px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
 border:2px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;color:#47362e;font-weight:750;position:relative;opacity:1!important;cursor:default!important}
.ex-card img{width:76px;height:105px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #c19c62;border-radius:6px}

 border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #7a5028;background:#74512f;color:#fff5de;font-size:14px;font-weight:850;cursor:pointer}

<body><canvas id="stage" aria-label="พื้นที่แสดงโต๊ะบอร์ดเกมสามมิติ ใช้เมาส์หรือใช้นิ้วลากหมุนโต๊ะ และใช้ปุ่มซูมเพื่อดูข้อมูลผู้เล่น"></canvas><div id="fallbackScene"></div><div id="vignette"></div>
<div id="hud">
 <div id="status"><div class="statuspill" id="turninfo">🎯 กำลังเชื่อมเกม COUP v3 · AI 5 คน · 6 ที่นั่ง</div></div>
 <div id="players" hidden aria-hidden="true"><div id="playersList"></div></div>
 <section id="panel" class="glass" aria-label="ตั้งค่ามุมกล้อง"><details id="cameraMenu"><summary>⚙️ มุมกล้อง · หมุนโต๊ะด้วยนิ้ว</summary><div class="camera-menu-content">
 <div class="controlrow"><button class="ctl active" id="seatBtn">👀 มุมที่นั่ง</button><button class="ctl" id="tableBtn">⬡ เห็นทั้งโต๊ะ</button><button class="ctl" id="focusBtn">◎ โฟกัสคนพูด</button>
</div>
 <div class="controlrow"><button class="ctl" id="previousBtn">◀ คนก่อน</button><button class="ctl" id="nextBtn">คนถัดไป ▶</button><button class="ctl" id="minusBtn">− ซูมออก</button><button class="ctl" id="plusBtn">＋ ซูมเข้า</button></div>
 <div class="controlrow"><button class="ctl" id="demoBtn">▶ ฉากสาธิต (ปิดในเกมจริง)</button><button class="ctl" id="resetBtn">↻ เริ่มต้นใหม่</button><button class="ctl" id="galleryBtn">🃏 ดูไพ่ใหม่ทั้งชุด</button><button class="ctl" type="button" id="modelInfoBtn">◈ ข้อมูลโมเดล GLB</button></div>
 <details id="avatarSelector" class="avatar-inline"><summary>🎭 เปลี่ยนตัวละครของคุณ (ชาย/หญิง)</summary><div class="avatar-panel"><div class="panel-title">🎭 ตัวละครของคุณ</div><div class="avatar-choices"><button id="boyChoice" class="avatar active" type="button"><span>👦</span> ผู้เล่นชาย</button><button id="girlChoice" class="avatar" type="button"><span>👧</span> ผู้เล่นหญิง</button></div><div class="avatar-info">สลับเฉพาะที่นั่งของคุณ · มี AI 5 คนคงเดิม</div></div></details>
 <div class="minihelp">🖱️ ลากเพื่อหมุนกล้อง · เลื่อนล้อเมาส์เพื่อซูม · มุมกล้องล็อกเหนือโต๊ะ · คลิกชื่อผู้เล่นเพื่อโฟกัส · ปุ่ม <b>1–6</b> เลือกผู้เล่น · <b>V</b> มุมที่นั่ง · <b>T</b> ภาพรวม</div></details></section>
 <div id="portraitBadge"><img id="portraitImg" alt="ภาพคอนเซปต์ตัวละคร"><span id="portraitLabel"></span><small>ภาพคอนเซปต์ CGI (ไม่ใช่โมเดล GLB)</small></div><div id="bubble" role="status" aria-live="polite"><strong id="bubbleName">ผู้เล่น</strong><p id="bubbleText">...</p><small id="bubbleAction">ACTION</small></div>
 <div id="labels"></div><div id="bottomnote">เกม COUP v3 เดิม · ไพ่ AI ยังเป็นความลับ · หมุนโต๊ะด้วยนิ้วหรือเมาส์</div><div id="toast"></div>
</div>
<section id="liveGameControls" class="glass" aria-label="การเล่นเกม COUP v3">
  <div class="live-action-title-row"><h2 id="liveTitle">🎲 COUP VS AI — ตั้งค่าเกม</h2><div id="liveHint">เริ่มเกมเพื่อแจกไพ่และให้ AI ทั้ง 5 คนเล่นตามกติกา COUP v3</div></div>
  <div id="gameActionButtons"></div>
  <div class="live-extra"><button id="liveNew" type="button">♻ เกมใหม่</button><button id="liveRules" type="button">📜 กติกา</button></div>
  <div id="liveLog" aria-live="polite"></div>
</section>
<aside id="myHandDock" aria-label="ไพ่ในมือของคุณที่เห็นตลอดเวลา" role="region">
  <div class="my-hand-heading"><strong>🃏 ไพ่ของคุณ</strong><small>ไพ่จริง · ดูได้เฉพาะคุณ</small></div>
  <div id="liveCards"><span>เริ่มเกมเพื่อเปิดดูไพ่ของคุณ</span></div>
</aside>

<div id="err"><div class="glass"><h2>ไม่สามารถเริ่มฉาก 3D ได้</h2><p>เบราว์เซอร์นี้ไม่รองรับ WebGL หรือปิดการเร่งกราฟิก กรุณาเปิดด้วย Chrome / Edge รุ่นปัจจุบันและเปิด Hardware Acceleration</p><p>โปรดลองเปิดด้วยเบราว์เซอร์ที่รองรับ WebGL เพื่อดูโมเดล GLB</p></div></div>

<div id="artDialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="artHeading" aria-hidden="true">
 <div class="art-panel">
  <div class="art-head"><div><h2 id="artHeading">ไพ่ COUP Classroom · ชุดภาพใหม่</h2><p>หน้าไพ่ 5 บทบาท และหลังไพ่ 1 แบบ · ออกแบบภาพจากขั้นที่ 3 · ใช้จริงบนโต๊ะ 3D</p></div><button class="art-close" type="button" id="closeArt" aria-label="ปิดหน้าต่าง">✕</button></div>
  <div id="artGrid" class="art-grid"></div>
  <div class="art-note">ไพ่ฝ่าย AI จะคว่ำไว้จนกว่าจะถูกเปิดเผยตามกติกา · ชุดไพ่บนโต๊ะจะอัปเดตตามเกม COUP v3 จริง</div>
 </div>
</div>
<script>
'use strict';
const el=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const cv=el('stage'),gl=cv.getContext('webgl',{antialias:true,alpha:false,depth:true,powerPreference:'high-performance'});
const CHARACTER_GLB={"player_boy":"
